title: On first meeting a future companion, before any dialogue has run, the menu already offers 'attack Vell with hunting knife (roll 9+ on the die)' — same pattern later for Brother Osk, Tamsin, and Lys. It reads as an easy way to accidentally kill a companion you haven't even talked to yet.
